attribution.text: Generated using Copernicus Climate Change Service information [Year]

provenance.notes: Read 2026-11-10: the how-to-api page and the Terms of Use (disclaimer-privacy) state no request rate, no concurrency and no User-Agent rule; content is used under the licence attributed to each dataset, accepted once per dataset on its page before the first request. Most CDS datasets are CC-BY-4.0 (licence page cc-by), others under the Licence to use Copernicus Products or restricted licences (e.g. CICERO CMIP6 indicators, E-OBS: non-commercial): licence null and commercial/storage/redistribution unknown at source level, check the dataset's licence. Credit: Licence to use Copernicus Products sec. 5.1 asks 'Generated using Copernicus Climate Change Service information [Year]' ('Contains modified ...' when modified). Catalogue reads need no key; submit/job need a personal access token (PRIVATE-TOKEN). Per-user caps on running/queued jobs (e.g. 12 simultaneous requests) appear only on undated ECMWF Confluence pages and the JS-rendered /live pages, not read: not declared. Requests are queued server-side. Contact: ECMWF support portal/forum (no API address published on the pages read). No rate-limit headers seen on a test call.
